core_problem_solved: To provide one of the early, comprehensive libraries for converting between Java objects (Beans, Maps, Collections), and even XML, and their JSON representations.
key_features: Conversion of Java Beans to and from JSON
Support for a tree-like navigation of JSON objects (`JSONObject`, `JSONArray`)
Utilities for transforming XML to JSON
era_and_niche: One of the early, feature-rich JSON libraries for Java, used in the mid-to-late 2000s before the current standards like Jackson and Gson emerged and stabilized.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **completely obsolete** and has been unmaintained for over a decade. It is known to be slow and has a complex API compared to modern alternatives. The entire Java community has long since standardized on **Jackson** and **Gson** for all JSON processing needs.
